verdict.rationale: Sketch's own docs show reusable Symbols that stay linked to their source: changes to a Symbol propagate to every instance, Nested Symbols are supported, and Library updates flow to consumers. Community users independently praise Symbols and Libraries for component-based design. However, nothing in the pack documents variants or per-instance overrides, which are two of the story's three core elements. Missing for 10: documented variants support, documented per-instance overrides that preserve the link to the source.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build reusable components with variants and per-instance overrides that stay linked to their source

citations.quote: When you make changes to a Symbol, those changes appear everywhere you use it in your designs.
Nested Symbols give you finer control over complex designs.
When you star a version in a Library document, anyone using that Library will receive a Library update.
It shines when you embrace Sketch symbols and libraries, allowing DRY, component-based designs.
